```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```


```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")

joined <- open_dataset("data/history.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  left_join(markets, by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric    = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    prediction_error   = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.numeric(as.Date(ymd_hms(resolved_at)) - date),
    horizon = case_when(
      days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 1 ~ "1 to 7 days",
      days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
    ),
    horizon = factor(
      horizon,
      levels = c(
        "More than 90 days",
        "30 to 90 days",
        "7 to 30 days",
        "1 to 7 days",
        "Final day"
      )
    )
  )

groups        <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket = horizon) |>
  summarise(
    mean_prediction_error = mean(prediction_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(accuracy)

ggplot(
  accuracy,
  aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_prediction_error, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Final-day forecast probability",
    y = "Number of snapshots"
  )
```

```{r}
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(
    probability_bin = cut(
      probability,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
      labels = paste0(seq(0, 90, by = 10), "-", seq(10, 100, by = 10), "%"),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(calibration)

ggplot(
  calibration,
  aes(
    x = (as.integer(probability_bin) - 0.5) / 10,
    y = actual_rate,
    size = n
  )
) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Markets in bin") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Observed YES rates generally increase with predicted probability",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual resolution rate"
  )
```
